facts.text: Serve the toasties when Carl makes his son a grilled cheese.
facts.why: The grilled cheese is a key scene. One write up describes it as Carl teaching Percy how to make a grilled cheese properly, so it may be Carl and Percy making it together. I could not confirm the exact moment or who cooks it.
facts.fix: Serve the toasties when Carl shows Percy how to make a grilled cheese.

facts.why: Wikipedia says Marvin offers Carl a rundown Grumman food truck. None of the pages I opened give the truck's name.

facts.text: Not to be served burnt. Ever
facts.why: The grilled cheese is shown being prepared with care, but I found no line about burnt toast in the sources.
facts.fix: Made with care for his son.

vibe.verdict: A food truck menu that follows the cross country route and the real dishes. It leaves out the Twitter fight, which is what the film runs on.
missing: The Twitter fight with Ramsey (Carl's meltdown)
Martin joining the truck (the line cook)
ideas: Add a 'Don't tweet angry' line to the footer, replacing the plain print line
Swap 'Food truck mojito' for a Cuban coffee, since Cuban food is the heart of the film
Add the Austin brisket stop to the road list, replacing 'On the road' filler note
Rewrite the lava cake note to name Riva's menu
